svg.title: Diagram: the five-layer pre-install inspection funnel
svg.desc: A hand-drawn notebook diagram. A vertical chain on the left runs from a box labelled The install button (instructions, scripts, permissions) through five numbered checks — source read, trigger pair, permission review with allowed-tools first, history pin, scanner read with score, suppressed and uncovered — to a final box: install, sandbox or decline, a habit not a certification. Each arrow carries the next verb: open, test, review, pin, scan, decide. A note card on the right lists what stays uncovered: static only with no live run, images and encrypted content, other runtimes unchecked, four skills not a census. The footer notes vendor stats are attributed with the paper pending, and permission semantics verified for Claude Code only. In the animated version the chain draws itself top to bottom, then ink dots travel down each arrow in turn.

text.tspan: five checks, each with a blind spot
Vendor stats attributed (Liu et al. via scanner docs); paper pending.
